description: This file implements classes and methods for managing QUIC connection IDs, including peer-issued and self-issued connection ID managers, handling connection ID frames, retirement, and related alarms within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: RetirePeerIssuedConnectionIdAlarm
classes.description: Alarm delegate class for retiring peer-issued connection IDs.

classes.name: RetireSelfIssuedConnectionIdAlarmDelegate
classes.description: Alarm delegate class for retiring self-issued connection IDs.

methods.name: QuicConnectionIdData
methods.description: Constructor for QuicConnectionIdData, storing connection ID, sequence number, and reset token.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdNew
methods.description: Checks if a new connection ID frame contains a connection ID not seen before.

methods.name: PrepareToRetireConnectionIdPriorTo
methods.description: Prepares connection IDs to be retired prior to a specified sequence number.

methods.name: OnNewConnectionIdFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming new connection ID frames, updating internal state and checking limits.

methods.name: ConsumeOneUnusedConnectionId
methods.description: Consumes and returns one unused connection ID, moving it to active.

methods.name: PrepareToRetireActiveConnectionId
methods.description: Marks an active connection ID for retirement.

methods.name: MaybeRetireUnusedConnectionIds
methods.description: Retires unused connection IDs not present on the current path.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdActive
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is currently active.

methods.name: ConsumeToBeRetiredConnectionIdSequenceNumbers
methods.description: Returns sequence numbers of connection IDs marked for retirement.

methods.name: ReplaceConnectionId
methods.description: Replaces an old connection ID with a new one in internal data structures.

methods.name: RetireConnectionId
methods.description: Retires connection IDs scheduled for retirement and notifies the visitor.

methods.name: GetUnretiredConnectionIds
methods.description: Returns all connection IDs that are not yet retired.

methods.name: MaybeIssueNewConnectionId
methods.description: Attempts to generate and reserve a new connection ID.

methods.name: MaybeIssueNewConnectionIdForPreferredAddress
methods.description: Issues a new connection ID for preferred address, if possible.

methods.name: OnRetireConnectionIdFrame
methods.description: Handles a retire connection ID frame, scheduling retirement and updating state.

methods.name: HasConnectionIdToConsume
methods.description: Checks if there are connection IDs available to consume.

methods.name: ConsumeOneConnectionId
methods.description: Consumes and returns one connection ID.
